The greatest show on the road. Chrysler Pacifica is an escape in itself. Its sophisticated suite of
technology services allows your passengers to get lost in entertainment, while drivers and
designated navigators stay informed and up to speed with the Uconnect® 5 system and its 10.1-
inch touchscreen, Alexa Built-In1* and the available Uconnect Theater, Amazon Fire TV® Built-In,2
wireless Apple CarPlay® support,3 Android AutoTM4 compatibility and an available 20-speaker
Harman Kardon® Premium Audio System. All the while, everyone rides with the peace of mind
that comes from advanced safety and security innovations like Full-Speed Forward Collision
Warning with Active Braking,5 LaneSense® Lane Departure Warning systems6 and ParkSense®
Park Assist.7 Thoughtful touches like the available FamCAMTM interior camera,8 heated and cooled
seating, Stow ’n Vac® integrated vacuum cleaner,® Stow ’n Go® seating make everything a little easier.
*A note about this brochure: all disclosures can be found on the last page.
